## Code Conventions

<!-- Brief summary. See docs/reference/CODING_STANDARDS.md for full standards -->

### Git

- **Workflow:** GitHub Flow (feature branches, squash merge)
- **Branch Naming:** `feature/<description>` or `feature/<story-id>-<description>`
- **Commit Format:** Conventional commits: `<type>(<scope>): <description>`
- **Never:** Push directly to main, force push, skip hooks

### Quick Reference

| I want to...         | Use                                |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Setup framework      | `/bootstrap`                       |
| Start working        | `/continue`                        |
| Begin new sprint     | `/sprint-start [branch-name]`      |
| Deliver a story      | `/story-cycle <description-or-id>` |
| Plan new work        | `/ideate <idea>`                   |
| Finish sprint        | `/sprint-end`                      |
| End session          | `/handoff`                         |
| Generate tech skills | `/skill-create`                    |

### Starting a Session

```
Opening Claude Code?
    |
    +-> First time? ----------> /bootstrap (auto-detect or vision flow)
    |
    +-> First time today? ----> /continue (analyzes git state)
    |
    +-> Ready to start work? -> /sprint-start [branch-name]
```

### During Development

```
Working on stories?
    |
    +-> Deliver a story ----> /story-cycle "description or story-id"
    |
    +-> Plan new work ------> /ideate "idea or requirement"
    |
    +-> Debugging? ---------> /debug-session "error description"
```

### Completing Work

```
Finishing a sprint?
    |
    +-> Full sprint ---------> /sprint-end
    |
    +-> Ending session ------> /handoff
```

## Git Workflow (GitHub Flow)

### Branch Naming

```
feature/<story-id>-<short-description>
```

### Sprint Workflow

1. **Start Sprint**: `/sprint-start` (creates branch from main)
2. **During Sprint**: `/story-cycle` (commit regularly)
3. **End Sprint**: `/sprint-end` (quality gates, PR, merge)

### Rules

- **NEVER push directly to main** - all changes via PR
- **Feature branches** - one branch per story/sprint
- **Delete merged branches** - keep repository clean
- **Squash merge** - keep main history clean
